decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks build directly on the firm's dental materials and thermoforming know-how, and their dedicated web presence supports continued commercialization and learning.
The PETG thermoforming blank is closely related to the firm's existing custom-device materials capabilities and fits its precision manufacturing and laboratory workflow customer base.
Although less prominently presented, UV-curing lacquer is still adjacent to the firm's established materials expertise, giving it a good basis to refine the product through in-house R&D.
Intraoral contrast spray complements the firm's move toward digital dentistry workflows and uses customer and application knowledge the firm already possesses.
The custom earmold product line strongly matches the firm's custom manufacturing skills and hearing-care channels, so the firm has high absorptive capacity to improve and scale it.
Custom hearing protection earmolds are a natural extension of the firm's earmold and hearing-related capabilities and can be supported through existing production and distribution resources.
